reviews.comment: Super fun class to take, she always has interesting stories and loves getting to know her students.

If you can take this class online, please do so!! If I took it online my rating would be a 4/5 instead; in person lectures are extremely boring and she often goes off track causing us to start late AND go over time; we also have to draw on sticky notes for attendance and turn them in, and they lost mine one time :(

Easy online class that was actually pretty interesting. Lots of readings but exams were open note. Tedious assignments but not actually difficult. A few group projects, just make sure to not do them last minute. Dr. Campagnol is very passionate about the subject which makes it more interesting!

Professor Campagnol is an incredible professor who truly wants to share her passion for architecture with her students. She takes a rounded approach to architecture history that you can't get elsewhere. Tests are all unproctored and online with unlimited time/attempts. You will only get out what you put into this class, given how easy exams are.

Be prepared find people for group projects. Very cheerful and brings such positive energy to her classes although she may get off topic sometimes. Found her lectures to be the most memorable of the ARCH history classes when taking exams and such. Video notes helped a lot and were actually interesting. Very easy, just do your work and pay attention

Attendance is worth 5% of your grade, most of the grades come from discussion posts and worksheets which total to around 1 hour of work per week. Just make sure you sit next to people you like the first few weeks to get a good group. She is super rambly, but also super nice and very passionate.
lots of assignments but her positive energy in class makes up for it. love her humor.

Extremely extroverted and cheerful. I'd say she's an ENFP, for those well-versed in MBTI. Just be alert to share things in class, more than half of which might be things about yourself rather than what's being taught.

Very sweet professor and the class was pretty easy. The exams came straight from lectures notes. Like most online classes, the group project was pretty annoying and trying to get ahold of group members was a pain but that isn't the professors fault, just be prepared and contact your group early.

Tests are unlimited attempts over weekends. You can't see your grade though, and questions randomize over each attempt. However, they're open note and most of the answers are verbatim from the notes so just go slow and its an easy A.

Pretty easy online class if you need it for credit. The tests are incredibly easy if you actually look/watch the lectures, and that's what the majority of your grade it. The work can be tedious, but it's not hard. I'm taking her ARCH350 online as well next semester. If you have the time, go ahead and take this course to knock a credit out.

All of her tests are online and open notes, she is super fun and the sweetest! Her class is easy all notes are online, and she is an easy grader, all you need to do is put forth a little effort. Everything in her course is fair and not difficult she even let us use google on tests if we wanted. Her final was the same as every other test so TAKE HER
Interesting class

This class has a ton of busy work. The class is 85% tests and 15% assignments so they really don't impact your grade that much but you still have to do them. Tests are open note, open time, and you can take them as many times as you want BUT, you don't get to know your grade after each attempt. It's not a terrible class but not great.

With textbook readings, video assignments, and discussions, there is a lot to keep up with this class. Lots of work that amounts to participation for grading. 5 exams over 5 modules that you can retake as many times as needed, but you don't know the grade until the test closes. Class participation and attendance is big. Passionate; boring lectures

LOVED HER AS A PERSON. Lectures were very hard to understand and boring. I didn't watch them and still did really well. I made sure to take my TIME on exams and find everything in the textbook or lecture slides.

Would def take again. She was the sweetest prof. I had trouble accessing her videos at first but she met with me outside of class hours, talked to canvas, talked to IT, and talked to the site operators. Exams, hw, extra  credit, 1 group project. If you stay on top of your work you will be fine. This class was interesting and fun.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Love professor Gabriela for arch350 but do not recommend her for studio. There was no structure to the class at all and it seemed that our project changed so many times as she thought of new things to include. She really has great passion and means well though.

Worst part was the group project since it was an online class w/ in person group project so your group makes or breaks that grade. Tests were open everything w/ unlimited attempts. Lots of little assignments but all were super easy and not super time consuming. Easy class just don't forget to do assignments. Super nice and easy to understand!

She's a really nice lady but was honestly not a great professor. Would go off on tangents during the first bit of lecture, then speed through the material. Was disrespectful of our time- would keep us overtime almost every lecture, sometimes not even talking about relevant material. Also did not always respond to my emails. So much busy work!!

This professor is super passionate about the subject and you can very clearly tell! She was also very sweet and engaging with students. There were some longer assignments and sometimes the powerpoints were confusing, but also I didn't attend class very frequently (like at all) and still made an A so it's not hard whatsoever!

The course can be an "easy A", but have to work for it. There are 5 exams multiple choice, 50 questions, and unlimited attempts/no time limit. You unfortunately will not get to see wrong answers after each 1/your grade, so take it more than once. Most are from the lecture notes/video, but takes a lot of time. Plus videos to watch for quiz grades.

She was great. I took it as an online 5-week course, and it was really easy and interesting to learn. There are 5 exams with 50 questions, about 90% of the questions are from the lectures, 5% from the textbook, and usually a question or two on the exams were nowhere to be found. Also, she gives a lot of extra credit. Overall I recommend her.

She is a great and sweet professor. You can tell she is very passionate about the subject. The homework assignments take a while to complete but are often extremely easy. She does class attendance questions. Tests are open notes and not proctored. She can be hard to understand sometimes but ultimately a great professor!! Take her!!!!!

Dr. Campagnol would probably be a better prof in person. Her online tests (open note and open internet) are glorified scavenger hunts, and kind of got on my nerves by the end of the year, but at least the content was easy to understand and somewhat interesting.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Easy easy easy A. Taken online, Shes a great prof that gives you everything you need to get a great grade. Most assignments are busy work, and the exams are open note. She teaches passionately about the material and offers a lot of extra credit.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Online Savvy--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this semester with Dr. Campagnol. She is very funny and is invested in her students. Tests are easy if you take the time to work on them and the homework is not bad as some of them are quite interesting to learn. I really enjoyed listening to Dr. Campagnol lecture and I enjoyed her energy and positivity. She brightened my day.

Professor Campagnol is one of the most passionate and lively teachers I have ever met. She is so fun to listen to and she cares so much about what she is teaching. She also cares a ton about her students and she is so inspiring. I would definitely take her again, her class was easy but also thoughtful and inspiring. Campagnol is THE BEST.
She was amazing! You should definitely read, but if you do the work, then you should be fine on the tests! She gives a lot of extra cred and she is so supportive!

1. Ignore her rating (trust) 2. lots of EXTRA CREDIT 4. Tests are slight, all the answers are in the assignments she gives 5. Each module has 2 textbook assignments (each one has like 30-50 mc questions, control F the pages and you'll find the answer very quick), participation assignments, and then the final test (ezy) TAKE THIS CLASS FOR UCC CRED
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Campagnol is a kind woman but most of the learning you do will happen outside of lectures. The powerpoints are pretty disorganized and unclear, she skips between them a lot during lectures, and doesn't always post each one she refers to so it's hard to find what you need for the tests, which are hard to understand too. Don't take for an easy A.

I haven't had this much busy work since HS, the TAs give the same feedback for every assignment, I submitted a muffin recipe and got a 100 once. Its not hard, but a lot of work for no reason. Prof can be hard to understand and she gets distracted ALOT. Not horrible for a 300+ UICD, but I really didn't care and she didn't make me care, free A.

Prof Campagnol is one of the most passionate, energetic professors I have ever met! She loves the content she covers and her exams and assignments are very doable! Her lectures are enjoyable and she does her best to learn everyone's names so she can engage with the class in a more personal way. Would take again
If you want an easy A, take this class. Most of the grade comes from a few open note, open lecture exams with unlimited time, and there is generous extra credit.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Super organized prof. Easy A. Do the assignments and don't wait last minute, they are time-consuming. Open book exams over the weekend with multiple attempts pretty easy. Lots of extra credit. Hard to not get an A or B.

Gabriela really cares for her students. She offers lots of extra credit! Make sure to start the class participation assignments early, and take your time on the exams. She has super interesting lectures! We had one group project but it was very easy. I learned a lot in this class, and I really recommend it.

CourseHero class, take it and you won't regret it. Tests are based off a test bank and somewhat confusing but overall, it was easy and simple. The professor is fine as hell, I wish I went to her office hours.

still don't know what I learned but managed to get a B. don't know a whole lot about the professor tbh. kind of a lot of work just for an elective class but I didn't enjoy the class so I may be biased. tests are open note so that's a plus.

you have to watch videos that are literally 40 minutes long for one assignment that is worth pretty much nothing of your grade, but it's required in order to pass... The tests didn't really make sense and were poorly formatted. She was really nice but the class was not great.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was super easy. The tests were open notes and open book so if you use the resources you should get an A everytime. Lots of homework but it is not hard. Extra credit covers most missed deadlines as well.
This is a pretty easy online class, but it is a lot of work. It was more than I expected and it was relatively disorganized. But it was also an easy A and the tests were open-note and pretty easy.

Do you need an easy A for an ICD credit? Well look no further! ARCH 250 is the easiest class I've taken here at TAMU. If you do every assignment and are diligent with the time you spend on the tests, it will be the easiest A of your life. The biggest thing is the tests, which are online and have unlimited time and attempts. Take it online.
Super easy A. Tests are not difficult, you have unlimited attempts. Homework is incredibly easy. Overall very easy A.

She really hands you everything you need in order to make an easy A in this class! Most of the work is not hard just requires time! She gives a lot of extra credit and most of the homework assignments are watching videos and answering questions! Her exams are unlimited time/attempts but do not tell you the grade after, but easy!
The tests are unlimited attempts and unlimited time, however, you can't see any of the scores until afterward. you can usually find everything on course hero.

To be honest I was really looking forward to learning the material in this course, but the way it was run I learned nothing. If you're looking to throw your money away in order to get a for sure A this is the professor for you. If you are actually looking to take a college level course I wouldn't recommend to anyone.
Very easy class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It's an online class so you have to manage your time well in order for you to actually learn. There's four tests including the final and they're all open book but you have to refer back to the assigned readings and lectures. You might be doing so-so all semester long, but she'll round you up. I had an 84 average and got an A.

Dr. Campognol's class is an easy A. I never watched her lectures and always got A's on the exams because all the answers are on CourseHero or can be found on Google. Exams are 80% of your grade. There are worksheets that you have to do by following along with a video but they are easy. Group project was graded lightly.

very nice and is excited about the material shes teaching, a lot of the buildings we learn about shes actually been to and has her own pictures which is cool, easy A if youre not cocky about it, most of the stuff you need to know for the tests can be found online or in her slides (all 5 are online but cant see score till after). shes pretty
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She's a good choice, if you're looking for an elective. All she does is lecture, which is boring, but you don't really have to be there. The best part is the exams are online and open note.

You can get an A but it takes some effort. Way too much information on the ppt slides and you have to watch a ton of documentaries. Sometimes on the tests, it will ask for something super specific from 1 of the documentaries and it's unrealistic to go watch it all over again to find just 1 answer. An A is possible but it's not a super easy A.

Dr. Campagnol's class overall was easy- there are 5 tests but they are long and tedious, but they are also open-note with unlimited time allowed and unlimited attempts (the best attempt is used for grade). Lots of videos to watch with questions to answer. However, lectures are long and boring.

Summer online class. Lectures are long and kinda boring, and thats if they work. Group project was a pain. 5 tests & basic busy work. Serious lack of organization. Never emailed her, but have heard lots of issues about it. Not a hard class but dont use this prof. Material was interesting but I dont recommend her.

The assignment are unclear and full of typos, emails are answered with intense attitude and the assumption that it is always you who screwed up, and most of the lectures available for download on ecampus don't work. Overall, the class is an easy A if you put in the time to google everything.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I've taken two of Dr. Campagnol's classes, and both times it's felt like I'm back at a community college. There is a very clear lack of effort. Not only does she use the exact same lectures for both ARCH 250 and 350, she makes you watch the same low-quality documentaries and complete the same assignments. Also her posted notes are always corrupted.

Dr. Campagnol is not the professor for you if you need to access her outside of class and expect a friendly response or if you want to actually understand half of the assignment instructions. However, in this online summer session we had 5 exams with unlimited attempts and roughly 3 assignments a week so it's definitely not hard to make an A.

For an online elective, the tests were difficult and the assignments were watching long videos. She was not that easily accessible, and the video assignments were long but pretty straightforward. However, there are five tests with unlimited attempts, which made it easier to make up for bad grades.

One of the easiest classes you can take at A&M. I didn't read a page of the textbook or PowerPoints and did very minimal work and still ended up with a high A in the class. Homework is pretty much graded for participation, there's one easy group project, and 5 exams. The exams are long and tedious, but easy to get a good grade on being open-note.
Super easy online class. Didnt even have to read the book. Aced the tests and the few homework assignments we had were easy. Take this online!

ARCH 250 relies heavily on exams (there are 5 of the but she drops the lowest if you pass the final). Each test has unlimited time and unlimited attempts. Dr. Campagnol takes the highest score and makes the course easy so you can focus on learning more than grades. the 20% of the class that isn't test is participation.

I took arch 250 expecting it to be easy, and wow it was very easy. You have homework and class participation videos to watch before every test, 5 tests total, and the tests are all online unlimited attempts and unlimited time. You see your grade once the test closes, but they're super easy. Overall very easy

Easy class that doesn't take critical thinking. Take it online-almost 80% of the questions from exams come from ppw(20% from participation assignments-watching videos & questions). Group project that should be easy... if your group meets up. Two extra credit opportunities for 1 point added to final grade. Lowest exam grade dropped. TAKE ONLINE!!!

I took Arch 250 online to get my ICD and Creative Arts credit, and it was not bad at all. There are 5 tests (lowest gets dropped) and almost all the questions come straight from her powerpoints. There was one fairly easy group project. There are participation activities that involve watching videos and answering questions also.

this prof rocks! She is hilarious and keeps class interesting. Tests were all about identifying buildings and homework is online and easy. I liked her class so much I'm taking her again for another class!

Professor Campagnol's class is fairly easy. I took her for an online course and got an A in it. There are 5 exams, no final. She only count 4 out of the 5 exams as a grade. There was a video group project that's really easy if the group worked together well and actually decides to meet up (since it's an online class). She also offered 2 extra cred.

Very sweet professor and manageable class. Tests have a lot of information on them but pretty easy to figure out the answers. Overall, pretty easy. Ended with an 88 because of the first test since I hadn't really figured out the best way to study for the class yet. Assignments are pretty easy. There was one group assignment.

It was an online class that was pretty easy. Unlimited tries on test, no time limit and they were open for 3 days at a time. There was one group project that was easy and you have 5 test and only 4 count towards your grade. The movie questions were a pain because they were long and her questions weren't always clear on them but overall not bad.
Good prof. Gives extra credit. 5 total non cumulative exams that are fairly easy. Online reading assignments. She is Brazilian and has an accent but is still easy to understand

Easy A if you study the night before and show up to class. The reason for going to class is to fill out these lecture notes that basically summarize the exams. Optional final if you already have an A or if you're fine with your grade which was dope. Definitely would take again she's pretty attractive, high energy and a solid prof.

Let me cut to the chase. She's a lovely person, but you canNOT understand half of what she is saying and have to really work to puzzle out what she is trying to get across in her open-ended lectures. Her "reviews" deserve the quotation marks around the word. STUDY EVERYTHING ON LE COURBUSIER. Literally everything. Loves the connections between ppl.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Very awesome professor.  I have her for two classes this semester (URPN 202 & ARCH 205).  Sometimes she is hard to understand because she is Brazilian and gets her words mixed up, but she is great.  And she's really pretty!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Really didn't expect to enjoy my architecture class, but she definitely proved me wrong. solid presentations, true love of the subject, energetic and funny. Show up, pay attention, jot down notes to help you remember buildings, review the class slides, and you'll be alright.

It is pretty clear cut, 4-5 tests, a few extra credit assignments based on 20 minute videos. She is hilarious and her lectures are interesting. If you pay attention in class, you will do fine on the tests. She does a lot of independent research and is a very interesting person. I recommend just going to her office hours and learning about her life.

Gabriela is wonderful. The best architecture professor that I know. She truly cares for the students, extremely helpful, smart and kind. Also, articulated in explaining ideas, with a lot of repertoire. She always makes me feel excited about the work and gives great advice and feedback for research.
Great Professor! Really cares whether or not you learn. Would definitely take another class from her.

Campagnol is pretty clear in class. Posts lectures online and shows a lot of videos in class. You don't really have to come, but if you don't you'll have to read the textbook. Has an accent but I didn't have trouble understanding. 5 tests but she takes your top 4 grades, lets you skip the final if you're okay where you are
